text.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌۭ

words.gloss_range: relative/appositional connector continuing the praised divine referent from 35:34
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِىٓ}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) opens as a dependent relative connector, not a fresh subject. It keeps 35:35 inside the praise begun in 35:34, so the one who removed sorrow is now identified by the completed act of settling the speakers. Even the lengthened opening sound serves that bridge: the ayah lingers on attachment before the settlement verb arrives.

topics.headline: relative continuation of prior praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah as continued grateful speech about the same praised Lord from 35:34, not as a new report.
topics.reason: The grammar and cross-reference evidence identify a relative/appositional connector whose antecedent lies in 35:34.

topics.headline: ayah-boundary bridge from removal to settlement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that removal of sorrow and settlement in the abode belong to one continuous speaker-referent chain across 35:34-35.
topics.reason: The boundary rows fit the relative clause evidence; the sound row is retained as supporting recitational payoff.

words.gloss_range: caused settlement or lodging, locally framed as granted admission into the abode
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes loosening, lawfulness, alighting, and settlement; the Form IV local frame selects caused lodging while preserving authorized-access pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: abode term linked as the settlement destination
source phrase naming bounty as the cause of settlement
permanence noun specifying the abode

words.prose: {{ar:أَحَلَّنَا}} ({{tr:aḥallanā}}) makes residence an effected placement: the praised Lord acts, the speakers are held inside the attached -nā, and {{ar:دَارَ}} ({{tr:dāra}}) follows directly as the occupied destination. The broad {{ar:ح ل ل}} ({{tr:ḥ-l-l}}) field is narrowed by this Form IV frame toward caused lodging, yet the source phrase {{ar:مِن فَضْلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:min faḍlihi}}) keeps authorized access and release from constraint alive. The aḥalla-plus-dār frame also has a contrastive use in 14:28, where placement goes toward ruin; here divine agency and {{ar:ٱلْمُقَامَةِ}} ({{tr:al-muqāmati}}) reverse the frame into permanent mercy.

topics.headline: caused settlement with visible recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees residence as granted emplacement received by the speakers, not self-arrival into a place.
topics.reason: Form IV perfect with the object suffix and direct abode complement supports caused settlement as the local frame.

topics.headline: lodging colored by authorized release
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lodging is also opened access and release from old constraint, while the local grammar keeps caused residence as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The broader root field is narrowed to authorization and release within settlement by the local Form IV abode frame.

topics.headline: aḥalla plus dār reversed from ruin to mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear 35:35 as a merciful reversal of an aḥalla-plus-dār placement into ruin in 14:28.
topics.reason: The supplied 14:28 rows give a concrete constructional contrast without overriding the local parse.

topics.headline: act-destination-source sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the clause as action, home, then source, so the verb governs both where the speakers are and why they are there.
topics.reason: The local order places the settlement verb before the abode and bounty phrase, and the permanence noun resolves arrival into continuance.

words.gloss_range: abode, dwelling-domain, or realm, locally the directly governed destination of settlement
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes turning, circling, enclosure, house, and domain; the local construct selects dwelling while retaining bounded-domain force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct phrase naming the permanent abode
locative pronoun phrase resuming the abode

words.prose: {{ar:دَارَ}} ({{tr:dāra}}) is the directly governed destination, but as the first term of {{ar:دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ}} ({{tr:dāra al-muqāmati}}) it is not an undefined home. The construct makes permanence specify the dwelling itself, and the later two {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) pronouns keep returning both no-touch clauses to this same bounded domain. The wider {{ar:د و ر}} ({{tr:d-w-r}}) field is narrowed to dwelling, while its enclosure pressure helps explain why toil and weariness are imagined as unable to cross the abode's boundary. The true-life abode contrast in 29:64 is realized here as a final dwelling specified by permanence and immunity from fatigue.

topics.headline: directly governed construct abode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the abode is an immediate occupied destination and one defined residence-domain, not a loose location.
topics.reason: The accusative role after the settlement verb and construct governance with the permanence noun are strongly licensed.

topics.headline: dwelling as bounded hardship-proof domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the home as a bounded realm repeatedly resumed by the locative pronoun, while the local phrase still selects dwelling rather than every circling branch of the root.
topics.reason: The enclosure field is useful because both locative pronouns resume the abode, but circulation and reversal branches remain background pressures.

topics.headline: final abode specified against hardship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can relate this abode to the true-life dār of 29:64, now specified by permanence and immunity from fatigue.
topics.reason: The supplied 29:64 echo gives a concrete abode comparison and the local closure returns to the abode through the second locative phrase.

words.gloss_range: permanent residence or established abiding, locally the genitive classifier of the abode
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes rising, standing, maintaining, establishing, and residing; the local m-form narrows it to stable residence rather than the resurrection event-name
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُقَامَةِ}} ({{tr:al-muqāmati}}) classifies the home as the abode of established residence. Its genitive case keeps permanence inside the construct rather than as a separate afterthought, and its m-form lets the word name both a place and a condition of lasting establishment. The {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) field is narrowed away from the resurrection event-name; here standing becomes maintained continuance, so the later exclusions of toil and weariness are consequences of a stable abode already named. The q-w-m thread from 35:14, 35:18, and 35:29, along with steadfast reassurance in 41:30, lands here as settled residence rather than another act of standing.

topics.headline: permanence classifies the abode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees permanence as the kind of home itself, not a later comfort added to the home.
topics.reason: The definite genitive term is syntactically bound under the abode noun and appears before the hardship pair.

topics.headline: standing field narrowed to stable residence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the standing root become maintained residence, while the local form blocks reading it as the resurrection event-name.
topics.reason: The noun-time/place m-form and construct setting support residence-stability; other q-w-m branches remain contrastive or background.

topics.headline: same-surah q-w-m thread lands in residence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track q-w-m language from standing and steadfastness into settled eschatological continuance, including the reassurance pattern of 41:30.
topics.reason: The supplied 41:30 and same-surah recurrence rows are concrete enough to preserve as a root-thread payoff.

topics.headline: residence phrase resolves the opening beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the residence phrase as the interpretive key that lands before the shorter no-contact clauses test it.
topics.reason: The timing and sound rows support a structural payoff: the phrase closes the first beat before negation begins.

words.gloss_range: source/cause preposition governing the bounty phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: possessed bounty noun governed by the source preposition

words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) turns the clause from destination to source. After the listener has heard the home, the preposition governs {{ar:فَضْلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:faḍlihi}}) and explains settlement as coming from bounty, because of bounty, and out of abundance. Placed before the two no-contact clauses, it also frames the absence of toil and weariness as an effect of that bounty, not as earned compensation.

topics.headline: source-cause of settlement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the abode as sourced in bounty rather than achieved by the speakers.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the bounty noun and attaches to the settlement frame as source/cause.

topics.headline: pivot from home to explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first receives the home, then has it reinterpreted as unearned favor before the negations arrive.
topics.reason: The phrase follows the named abode and precedes the no-touch clauses, making it a hinge in the local order.

words.gloss_range: His bounty, surplus favor, or preferential grace as source of settlement
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes surplus, excellence, preference, and favor; the local possessive source phrase selects generous bounty rather than wages

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: toil noun barred from contact in the first denial

words.prose: {{ar:فَضْلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:faḍlihi}}) is the possessed source of the settlement. The suffix points back to the same praised giver, so the bounty is not generic generosity but His bounty, and the verbal noun presents bounty as a source-field behind residence and rest. The {{ar:ف ض ل}} ({{tr:f-ḍ-l}}) field is narrowed here to surplus favor and preferential bestowal: the abode comes from overflow, not as wages for {{ar:نَصَبٌ}} ({{tr:naṣabun}}). The request from divine bounty in 4:32 and the increase from bounty in 35:30 sharpen that payoff, because the surplus is realized in 35:35 as settled rest.

topics.headline: His bounty as source-cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the settlement and rest tied to the same praised giver's own bounty, not to an impersonal benefit.
topics.reason: The genitive under the preposition and possessive suffix are syntactically forced and refer back to the praised Lord.

topics.headline: surplus favor rather than wages
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that final residence is framed as overflowing favor, not a measured repayment for endured toil.
topics.reason: The local source phrase selects favor and surplus; preference and excellence remain relevant as bestowal, not unrelated ranking.

topics.headline: bounty thread realized as rest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear earlier divine bounty language, including 4:32 and 35:30, realized as permanent residence and relief from fatigue.
topics.reason: The supplied references are concrete and their payoff is local: bounty explains both entry and bodily immunity.

topics.headline: source phrase bridges to non-contact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the bounty phrase mediate between being placed in the home and having hardship unable to touch inside it.
topics.reason: The phrase stands immediately before the first negated contact clause, bridging the settlement beat and rest architecture.

words.gloss_range: negator opening the first no-contact clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: toil noun barred from contact in the first denial

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) opens the first denied-contact clause and scopes over the verbal event, not just over the noun at the end. The claim is therefore not merely that toil is absent; it is that no event of {{ar:نَصَبٌ}} ({{tr:naṣabun}}) touching the speakers occurs in the abode. This first negator also establishes the frame that the second {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) will repeat.

topics.headline: first full contact-event negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears toil barred as an arriving contact event, not simply omitted from a list of discomforts.
topics.reason: The negator precedes an imperfect verb whose postponed indefinite subject is the toil noun, so its scope covers the event.

topics.headline: first half of the negation refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader anticipates a repeated frame in which each hardship receives its own denial.
topics.reason: The later repeated negator confirms that the first particle starts a paired architecture.

words.gloss_range: touches us or reaches us by contact, locally negated with toil as postponed subject
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes physical touching, direct contact, and afflictive reaching; the local clause selects tactile non-contact rather than an inner-feeling statement

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: toil noun barred from contact in the first denial

words.prose: {{ar:يَمَسُّنَا}} ({{tr:yamassunā}}) turns hardship into attempted contact. The imperfect keeps non-contact ongoing, the attached -nā makes the speakers the protected object, and the postponed {{ar:نَصَبٌ}} ({{tr:naṣabun}}) becomes the would-be toucher. This is stronger than saying they do not feel tired: the tactile {{ar:م س س}} ({{tr:m-s-s}}) frame makes toil unable to reach their boundary in the abode. The same no-touch formula recalls 15:48, but 35:35 revoices it as first-person grateful speech and then uses the exact verb again for weariness.

topics.headline: toil externalized as barred contact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees toil as an external force unable to touch the saved speakers, not merely as a feeling they lack.
topics.reason: The verb has the speaker suffix as object and the toil noun as postponed subject, licensing the tactile externalization.

topics.headline: ongoing simple direct non-contact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the simple Form I imperfect denies continuing direct contact, without causative or reciprocal mediation.
topics.reason: The local form is imperfect Form I with an attached object suffix under negation.

topics.headline: first no-touch template echoed and repeated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a known no-touch formula from 15:48 adapted into first-person praise and made into the template for two hardships.
topics.reason: The supplied 15:48 rows are concrete, and the exact second touch verb confirms the template payoff.

topics.headline: geminated contact sound binds the clauses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the contact pressure concentrated in the repeated m-s-s sound while negation prevents that pressure from landing on the speakers.
topics.reason: The sound rows support a recitational payoff aligned with the repeated contact verb; they do not create a separate parse.

words.gloss_range: in it or within that domain, with the suffix resuming the abode

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct phrase naming the permanent abode
toil noun barred from contact in the first denial

words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) pulls the first no-touch claim back into {{ar:دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ}} ({{tr:dāra al-muqāmati}}). The feminine suffix agrees with the abode, and the preposition marks both interior location and governing domain: toil cannot touch them in that place and under that place's conditions. Because {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) comes before {{ar:نَصَبٌ}} ({{tr:naṣabun}}), the protected domain is heard before the hardship noun.

topics.headline: pronoun resumes the protected abode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader knows the no-toil claim belongs to the named abode, not to a vague state of mind.
topics.reason: The suffix is licensed as referring to the abode, and the preposition attaches the denied event to that domain.

topics.headline: protected domain before hardship subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the abode as the filter before the excluded toil is named, and that slot is prepared for repetition.
topics.reason: The locative phrase precedes the postponed subject and is repeated in the second clause.

words.gloss_range: toil, strain, or wearisome burden, locally the postponed subject barred from contact
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes setting up, appointed share, and fatigue; the local no-touch clause selects toil-strain while retaining imposed-burden pressure
words.prose: {{ar:نَصَبٌۭ}} ({{tr:naṣabun}}) lands at the end of the first denial as the postponed subject of the touch verb. Its indefiniteness under negation gives any-instance force: no strain of toil reaches them. The {{ar:ن ص ب}} ({{tr:n-ṣ-b}}) field is narrowed to wearisome burden, while its setting-up and allotted-share pressures make the toil feel like an imposed load that the abode cancels. The word also recalls no-touch fatigue language in 15:48 and struggle-burden language in 9:120, now answered by a realm where active strain cannot touch.

topics.headline: indefinite toil as barred subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees any instance of toil made the grammatical toucher and then barred from contact.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative, indefinite, and postponed after the negated touch verb.

topics.headline: toil colored as imposed burden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels toil as a burden set upon the body, while the local clause keeps fatigue/strain as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root family supports set-up and portion imagery, but the no-touch construction selects wearisome strain.

topics.headline: no-touch formula and struggle burden answered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear 15:48's no-touch formula and 9:120's struggle burden revoiced as protected rest.
topics.reason: Both supplied references are concrete and locally tied to the toil noun.

topics.headline: active strain before depleted aftermath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes active strain from the later depleted aftermath, so the two hardship nouns are not loose synonyms.
topics.reason: The two indefinite nominative hardship nouns close parallel clauses and are ordered as effort then residue.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the second full negated clause to the first

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: toil noun barred from contact in the first denial
fused conjunction and renewed negator opening the second denial
weariness noun barred from contact in the second denial

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge between the two no-touch clauses. It coordinates a second complete verbal denial, not just another noun after {{ar:نَصَبٌ}} ({{tr:naṣabun}}); the fused surface of {{ar:وَلَا}} ({{tr:wa-lā}}) makes addition and renewed negation arrive together. That keeps {{ar:لُغُوبٌ}} ({{tr:lughūbun}}) from becoming a lesser afterthought and prepares the mirrored clause.

topics.headline: coordination of two full denials
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears weariness added as a separately excluded force, not as a simple appendage to toil.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second negated verbal clause with the first.

topics.headline: compact wa-lā hinge into the mirror
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the turn from the first hardship to the second without any change in clause architecture.
topics.reason: The written fusion with the following negator starts the second mirrored no-touch frame.

words.gloss_range: renewed negator opening the second no-contact clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: repeated touch verb in the paired denials
fused conjunction and renewed negator opening the second denial

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) renews the negation before the second {{ar:يَمَسُّنَا}} ({{tr:yamassunā}}) clause. Even inside the fused {{ar:وَلَا}} ({{tr:wa-lā}}) surface, it remains a full sentential negator, so weariness receives its own barred-contact event. The repeated particle makes the two denials formally and acoustically parallel, closing the ayah's rest architecture with a second complete exclusion.

topics.headline: second full sentential negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees weariness independently denied, not merely swept under the first negation.
topics.reason: The second particle precedes its own imperfect verb and retains full negating force within the fused form.

topics.headline: second negation mirrors and completes the rest pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears total rest through repeated syntax as much as through the two hardship nouns.
topics.reason: The repeated negator restarts the full clause frame and mirrors the first denial.

words.gloss_range: touches us or reaches us by contact, repeated with weariness as postponed subject
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes physical touching, direct contact, and afflictive reaching; the repeated local clause selects the same tactile non-contact mechanism for exhaustion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: weariness noun barred from contact in the second denial
geminated consonant inside the repeated touch verb
possessed bounty noun referenced without the final recitation mark

words.prose: The second {{ar:يَمَسُّنَا}} ({{tr:yamassunā}}) repeats the same contact mechanism, now with {{ar:لُغُوبٌ}} ({{tr:lughūbun}}) as postponed subject. The speakers remain the protected object, and weariness becomes another external force that cannot touch them. Because the verb is repeated exactly, active strain and depleted exhaustion receive equal syntactic treatment. The second geminated {{ar:س}} ({{tr:sīn}}) repeats the compressed contact pressure of the first verb, binding the two exclusions by sound as well as syntax. The 50:38 touch-and-weariness echo is narrowed to contrast: 50:38 denies creator-fatigue, while 35:35 grants creatures derivative rest through {{ar:فَضْلِهِ}} ({{tr:faḍlihi}}).

topics.headline: weariness externalized as second barred contact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exhaustion as a second would-be toucher stopped at the same boundary as toil.
topics.reason: The second verb takes the speaker suffix as object and the weariness noun as postponed subject.

topics.headline: exact repeated touch template equalizes denials
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second denial as structurally equal to the first, not as an afterthought.
topics.reason: The same Form I imperfect with the same object suffix and locative frame recurs.

topics.headline: 50:38 weariness echo revoiced for creatures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear 50:38 behind the phrase while recognizing that 35:35 changes the beneficiary from divine non-fatigue to creaturely rest by bounty.
topics.reason: The supplied echo is concrete, but it is contrastive and cannot govern the local creaturely grammar.

topics.headline: second geminated contact pressure closes the pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same contact pressure return at the close, binding the two hardship exclusions.
topics.reason: The sound and exact-repetition rows preserve a real recitational/structural payoff without adding a new lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: in it or within that same domain, repeating the abode reference

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct phrase naming the permanent abode

words.prose: The second {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) re-locks the weariness denial to the same {{ar:دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ}} ({{tr:dāra al-muqāmati}}). Its feminine suffix blocks any shift of realm between toil and weariness, and its repeated locative slot makes the abode a refrain before each hardship noun. The domain reading remains active: exhaustion is denied within that place and under its protected conditions.

topics.headline: same abode re-locked for weariness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader knows the weariness denial happens in the same protected domain as the toil denial.
topics.reason: The suffix again refers to the abode, and the preposition locates the second denied event there.

topics.headline: repeated locative slot completes the mirror
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah return to the abode before naming each excluded hardship.
topics.reason: The second locative phrase repeats the slot from word 9 before the postponed subject.

words.gloss_range: deep weariness, depleted fatigue, or exhaustion after exertion
words.root_gloss_range: root range is comparatively narrow around fatigue and languor; the local noun selects depleted aftermath rather than generic toil

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: toil noun barred from contact in the first denial
accepted vowel variant of the weariness noun
guttural consonant inside the closing weariness noun
final consonant of the closing weariness noun
weariness noun barred from contact in the second denial

words.prose: {{ar:لُغُوبٌۭ}} ({{tr:lughūbun}}) closes the ayah with depleted weariness, not a generic synonym for {{ar:نَصَبٌ}} ({{tr:naṣabun}}). Its indefinite nominative form makes any instance of deep exhaustion the final postponed subject barred from contact, and its narrow {{ar:ل غ ب}} ({{tr:l-gh-b}}) field names the spent aftermath of effort. The qiraat {{ar:لَغُوبٌ}} ({{tr:laghūbun}}) changes vowel texture without moving the grammar or semantic field. Because the word is rare and echoes 50:38, the close is dense: creator-fatigue is denied there, while here creaturely exhaustion cannot touch those settled by bounty. Sound and cadence reinforce the seal, with the paired -un endings, the guttural {{ar:غ}} ({{tr:ghayn}}), and the final {{ar:ب}} ({{tr:bāʾ}}) binding {{ar:نَصَبٌ}} ({{tr:naṣabun}}) to {{ar:لُغُوبٌ}} ({{tr:lughūbun}}) while keeping their stages distinct.

topics.headline: deep exhaustion as final barred subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the last word as the named exhausted residue that cannot touch the speakers.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative, indefinite, and functions as the postponed subject of the second touch verb.

topics.headline: weariness after active strain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes active toil from the drained aftermath that would normally follow it.
topics.reason: The fatigue field is narrow and the word follows the toil noun in a paired clause.

topics.headline: laghūbun variant changes sound not role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the accepted vowel variation as recitational texture while the subject role and fatigue sense remain stable.
topics.reason: The variant changes the initial vowel but preserves consonants, nominative ending, root, and local grammar.

topics.headline: rare lughūb echo revoiced from 50:38
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the rare 50:38 fatigue denial behind the close, while 35:35 makes bounty, not divine essence, the explanation for creaturely rest.
topics.reason: The supplied echo and rarity rows are valid, but the local beneficiary and source phrase narrow the comparison.

topics.headline: heavy sound and paired cadence seal the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final fatigue noun as a marked seal on the abode's immunity from depletion.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows align with the final-word position, rare vocabulary, and paired indefinite cadence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb at word 2 governs the abode at word 3, and word 4 specifies continuing residence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A caused arrival becomes settled belonging: the addressees are not merely shown a location but installed as residents in a home whose defining condition is continued habitation.

activation_trace.role: The branch's act of lodging at a place supplies arrival and makes the causative verb an installation of residents.
Attachment to and residence in a home turns the named abode from bare location into belonging.
Residence in a place supplies settled duration and fixes the granted lodging as continuing habitation.

changed_reading.before: He placed us in a permanent home.
changed_reading.after: He caused an arrival that becomes settled belonging: they are installed as enduring residents rather than temporary guests.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The residence at word 4 is explicitly sourced from favor at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: The source of residence is both excess beyond need and a non-obligatory gift; paired with the support sense of standing, favor is not decorative sentiment but the surplus that grants and keeps the abode viable.

activation_trace.role: What keeps a thing standing supplies the residence's continuing support rather than duration alone.
Excess remaining beyond requirement supplies the abode's character as surplus rather than bare sufficiency.
A freely conferred benefit makes that sustaining surplus a donor's gift rather than a resident's claim.

changed_reading.before: The home is given by divine favor.
changed_reading.after: An unowed surplus both grants the home and supplies what keeps its life permanently standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same negated contact verb occurs at words 8 and 12, with toil at word 10 and debility at word 14 as its two subjects.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated contact construction creates an access boundary. Active exertion and the weakness left in its wake are not merely absent; neither can reach the residents or produce an effect in them.

activation_trace.role: Direct bodily contact gives the repeated negation a boundary-like literal force.
An effect reaching a person turns denied touch into denied causal impact.
Exertion, hardship, and enervating affliction supply the active burden barred from the residents.
Weakness and spent fatigue supply the depleted condition that is likewise unable to reach them.

changed_reading.before: They experience neither fatigue nor weariness there.
changed_reading.after: Neither exertion nor its residual debility has causal access to them; the abode excludes even first contact with depletion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The residence noun at word 4 is immediately disambiguated by the negated exhaustion terms at words 10 and 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: One branch of standing can be the halt of a mount that is exhausted and unable to continue. The two fatigue negations prevent permanent residence from sounding like forced stoppage: this is settled continuity without incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Continuing residence supplies the primary settled sense.
Stopping through exhaustion supplies a live negative alternative that the following clauses cancel.
Enervating toil is explicitly excluded, so settledness cannot be a collapse under effort.
Debilitating weakness is excluded, completing the distinction between rest and failed motion.

changed_reading.after: Permanent residence is secure rest without immobilization: continuity remains fully alive and capable, not stalled by exhaustion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier alternation between opening mercy and unanswerable holding activates a selectively permeable abode: grace is admitted and made resident, while exhaustion is denied even contact.

activation_trace.role: Opening what was closed and widening an entry supplies the positive ingress side of the mechanism.
Tender mercy identifies what the opened route admits.
Holding and confinement supply the counterforce that can block movement, making access itself salient.
Release from restriction lets the causative lodging also carry granted access.
Denied harmful effect supplies the closed side of the abode's selective boundary.

structural_cues: 35:2 alternates what is opened and what is held; 35:35 similarly places gracious admission beside two denied contacts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opened mercy, irresistible holding, granted access, and denied harmful effect; I infer a boundary that admits gift and bars depletion. A live alternative is that the verses only juxtapose divine control and bodily ease without describing the abode spatially.

changed_reading.before: Grace causes entry, and fatigue happens not to occur inside.
changed_reading.after: The abode itself functions as a selective threshold: opened grace enters and settles, but depletion cannot cross into contact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured lives are lengthened and diminished, day and night enter one another, and celestial bodies run to a fixed term. Against that ordered attrition, the abode of residence becomes a non-eroding mode rather than merely a very long interval.

activation_trace.role: Life extended through time supplies a measurable temporal span.
Loss of part of a thing supplies temporal decrement within mortal life.
One period entering another supplies continuous cyclic replacement.
Ongoing movement supplies the cosmos's directed temporal motion.
A fixed terminal time gives that motion a measured limit.
Circulating conditions let the abode carry the background of changing turns that residence overcomes.
Continuing residence supplies the stable condition set against decrement and terminal motion.

structural_cues: The packet moves from recorded lifespan in 35:11 through cosmic cycles in 35:13 to the residence claim in 35:35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decrementing lives, interpenetrating periods, motion toward a term, and continuing residence; I infer that permanence changes the residents' temporal regime. The live alternative is endless duration within ordered time rather than existence outside attrition or succession.

changed_reading.after: The residence is not consumed by the decrement, replacement, and terminal motion that measure ordinary existence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ships move through and cut resistant water in order to seek favor; the focus speakers are then lodged from that same favor. A sought surplus at the end of strenuous motion becomes the substance of settled arrival.

activation_trace.role: A vessel moving through water supplies the mobile platform of the search.
Cutting water in forward motion supplies resistance and directed effort.
Active seeking supplies the journey's purpose.
Freely conferred benefit names what the travelers seek beyond immediate provision.
Lodging at a destination converts the earlier motion into arrival.
Continued residence makes the arrival a final settled condition.

structural_cues: 35:12 orders vessel, water-cutting, seeking, and favor; 35:35 orders favor, lodging, residence, and the end of fatigue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material journey seeking favor and a later home sourced from favor; I infer a motion-to-arrival analogy in which the sought surplus becomes settlement. Alternatively, the maritime scene may only illustrate present provision and not map onto the later residence.

changed_reading.before: The home is an isolated gift after earthly life.
changed_reading.after: The home is the settled form of the surplus earlier sought through resistant motion: search terminates in gifted arrival without further fatigue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence distinguishes a trade that does not fail, wages paid in full, and then an increase from favor. Because the focus explicitly sources the residence from favor, the home belongs most sharply to the increment beyond settled compensation.

activation_trace.role: Commerce seeking gain supplies the accounting frame.
Stagnation ending in loss supplies the failure that this commerce escapes.
Completion without deficiency establishes that earned recompense is fully settled first.
Payment for work supplies the category of due compensation.
Growth beyond the completed amount supplies a second, additive stage.
Surplus beyond requirement identifies the increase as excess rather than unpaid wages.
A non-obligatory benefit makes the residence itself part of that additional generosity.

structural_cues: 35:29-30 moves from successful commerce to full wages and only then to increase; 35:35 repeats the source of that increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a staged account of full wages followed by increase from favor and later names favor as the home's source; I infer that the home is located in the beyond-wage increment. A live alternative is that favor summarizes the entire reward economy rather than only its excess stage.

changed_reading.before: The residence is reward for faithful work.
changed_reading.after: Work is fully recompensed, but the residence is voiced as the further surplus that no wage account by itself can demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inherited trust belongs to a selected plurality internally differentiated as wronging, moderate, and foremost; the narrative then shifts to plural entry and finally 'us' in the residence. Grace can therefore gather unequal trajectories into one inhabited outcome without pretending they earned it identically.

activation_trace.role: Transmission of a book or virtue as inheritance supplies a shared received trust.
Selection of a chosen group supplies the plural community under discussion.
A middle course supplies one distinct trajectory within that community.
Advancing ahead supplies another, non-identical trajectory.
A freely granted benefit supplies the umbrella under which differentiated paths can converge.
Movement into an interior carries the selected plurality across the threshold together.
Being lodged turns plural entry into a common resident condition.

structural_cues: Three repeated subgroup clauses in 35:32 are followed by plural entry in 35:33 and first-person plural residence in 35:35.
The packet does not explicitly resolve whether every subgroup remains the antecedent of the later plurals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection, three unequal paths, plural entry, and plural lodging by favor; I infer convergence without erased differentiation. The live alternative is a narrowed antecedent in which only an admitted subset speaks, so the social breadth remains uncertain.

changed_reading.before: An undifferentiated blessed group reports its home.
changed_reading.after: The plural home can gather inheritors of unequal prior trajectories, with shared residence grounded in favor rather than equal merit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding praise reports grief actively taken away; the focus then reports toil and weakness unable to touch. Ease has two phases: removal of an already borne inward roughness, followed by prevention of any new depletion.

activation_trace.role: Departure and removal supply an active clearing of a prior condition.
The inward roughness of grief identifies what is first removed.
Denied impact changes repair into continuing protection from renewed harm.
Toil and affliction supply one future source of depletion that cannot arrive.
Residual weakness supplies the other depleted state barred from recurrence.

structural_cues: 35:34 uses an accomplished removal, while 35:35 uses two present negations of contact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies removed grief followed by present-tense denied contact with toil and weakness; I infer a sequence from cure to prophylaxis. Alternatively, the tense and clause shift may intensify praise without encoding two distinct phases.

changed_reading.before: The residents simply feel no sorrow or fatigue.
changed_reading.after: What they carried is first removed, and the abode then prevents new exertion or debility from ever taking hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next scene also withholds an ending: its inhabitants are not finished by death, receive no lightening, cry out, and seek exit. Duration is therefore neutral. The focus residence is desirable because gracious placement and impermeability to harm give permanence its quality.

activation_trace.role: A final decree enacted as death supplies the ending that is withheld in the contrasting condition.
Loss of life and power identifies the unavailable exit from that condition.
Reduction of weight supplies the relief that is also withheld.
Painful punishment supplies the continuing harmful effect that cannot be lightened.
A loud appeal for rescue makes the intolerability of continued residence audible.
Movement out of an interior supplies the exit unsuccessfully requested.
Continuing residence supplies the shared structural feature whose value must be disambiguated.
Exclusion of harmful impact supplies the decisive qualitative difference.

structural_cues: 35:35 and 35:36 both use paired negations, but one denies harmful contact while the other denies both death and relief.
35:37 adds an explicit but unsuccessful request to leave the contrasting interior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent unending conditions with opposite experiential effects; I infer that the next scene semantically disambiguates the goodness of residence by quality rather than duration. A live alternative is simple rhetorical contrast without any revision of the residence noun itself.

changed_reading.before: The abode is blessed because it is permanent.
changed_reading.after: Permanence alone is not the blessing; gracious belonging and the impossibility of harmful impact make this permanence habitable rather than inescapable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later image of heavens and earth continuously held from displacement activates residence as active preservation. The abode remains because divine maintenance prevents its order from slipping; its residents do not bear that maintenance as labor.

activation_trace.role: Continuous holding supplies the preserving force that keeps an ordered domain in place.
Departure from place or condition supplies the displacement being prevented.
Care, preservation, and governance make residence an actively maintained condition.
The support by which a thing remains standing supplies durable habitability.
Changing turns supply the instability that maintained residence withstands.

structural_cues: 35:41 repeats holding around a counterfactual loss of place, making stability an ongoing act rather than a passive property.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic holding against displacement and focus branches of preservation and support; I infer that the abode's permanence is continuously maintained and that this work is not shifted to its residents. Alternatively, cosmic preservation may illustrate power only, while the focus residence remains a simple duration term.

changed_reading.before: The abode is permanent because it is intrinsically static.
changed_reading.after: Its permanence is an ongoing act of preservation: the domain is held in stable habitability without making its residents sustain it through toil.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, a heavy bearer cannot transfer even part of its load to another and each moves toward a destination. The focus does not picture relief as someone else carrying the burden; it pictures a destination where burden no longer reaches anyone.

activation_trace.role: A heavy burden supplies the individually borne load that cannot be reassigned.
Being loaded down supplies the pressure prompting an appeal for help.
Bearing an entrusted or culpable load supplies the nontransferable act of carrying.
Becoming toward a final outcome gives the burden-bearing sequence a destination.
Enervating labor supplies the load-effect absent at the destination.
Denied impact marks cessation of burden rather than its displacement onto another bearer.

structural_cues: 35:18 emphatically denies interpersonal transfer of a load before naming a destination; 35:35 emphatically denies the effects of load-bearing at the residence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nontransferable load-bearing, a destination, and later denied exhaustion; I infer that final relief removes the load's operation rather than outsourcing it. The live alternative is that legal accountability in 35:18 and bodily fatigue in 35:35 remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: The residents are relieved of work.
changed_reading.after: Their relief is not burden shifted to another creature; at the destination, the burdening relation itself no longer reaches them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus syntax and dominant mapping strongly favor causative lodging. It remains live because the packet explicitly gives the focus consonantal root a second mapped target for ornament and the immediately preceding ayah activates that target with bodily adornment; downstream prose should present it only as secondary wordplay, not replace the lodging sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb at word 2 has an explicit non-dominant mapping to the same target activated by adornment immediately before it, while word 6 supplies received good.

activation_trace.role: Being furnished with ornament activates adornment immediately before the focus verb.
An ornament encircling the hand makes the prior adornment materially concrete.
A precious bead supplies a second concrete material of investiture.
The focus root's non-dominant ornament target lets lodging resonate as being invested with the abode.
Good reaching someone supports hearing the home itself as a conferred good.

changed_reading.before: He lodged us in the enduring abode.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, He invested us with the enduring abode: the home itself becomes the culminating adornment and good conferred on its residents.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This competes with the stronger beyond-wage reading and is surprising because favor normally resists entitlement. It remains anchored in the focus verb's branch of an obligation becoming due and in the nearby sequence of full payment plus favor; downstream prose should frame it as a juridical resonance in which the giver creates the claim, never as merit independently binding the giver.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative verb at word 2 can activate a falling-due branch, while word 6 explicitly locates the cause in the giver's favor.

activation_trace.role: Full completion supplies a juridical environment of settled obligation.
Payment for work supplies the nearby category of what is due.
A freely conferred addition prevents the juridical reading from becoming independent human entitlement.
An obligation falling due lets the causative verb resonate as making settlement effective or due.
The donor's unowed gift supplies the sole source of the newly effective claim.

changed_reading.before: The residence is either earned compensation or an unowed gift.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, grace itself makes the promised settlement come due: the claim is effective, yet its entire ground remains the giver's prior generosity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the ordinary focus noun denotes a home, not defeat circling a group. It remains anchored in that noun's adverse-turn branch and in the later image of evil descending around its own people; downstream prose should label it a spatial reversal, with gracious enclosure replacing hostile encirclement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The abode noun at word 3 has an adverse-circuit branch, and the repeated contact negation defines what may not penetrate its enclosure.

activation_trace.role: A harmful turn circling and defeating a group supplies the negative enclosure that the abode reverses.
Denied harmful effect makes the new enclosure protective rather than punitive.
Harm descending and encompassing supplies the later explicit geometry of hostile encirclement.
A group bound by belonging identifies those enclosed by the consequence of their own action.

changed_reading.before: The dār is simply the residents' permanent house.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a reversed circle: instead of an adverse turn enclosing its people, gracious habitation encloses them while harm cannot enter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus fatigue noun ordinarily names weariness, while its long-pursuit branch is remote. It remains anchored in that supplied branch and is activated by the closing sequence of earthly travel, historical outcome, delay, and appointed term; downstream prose should render it as a secondary temporal image, not a lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final focus noun at word 14 carries a prolonged-chase branch, while the residence noun at word 4 supplies the settled endpoint.

activation_trace.role: A prolonged chase supplies an extended condition of being driven rather than merely feeling tired.
Settled residence supplies the endpoint at which pursuit ceases.
Travel through the earth supplies ongoing human motion before the endpoint.
A final outcome supplies the terminus disclosed by that travel.
Deferral to a later time supplies the interval during which the endpoint still pursues the traveler.
The fixed terminal time supplies the limit that eventually ends deferral and motion.

changed_reading.before: No weariness is felt after arrival.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, no long pursuit by travel, consequence, or deferred term reaches them: residence is the end of being driven through time.

strongest_changes: The wage-plus-increase sequence makes the residence most sharply an excess of favor beyond completed compensation.
The immediately following unrelieved condition shows that permanence is neutral until gracious belonging and exclusion of harm make it habitable.
The later holding of heavens and earth turns residence from inert duration into continuously maintained stability whose labor is not borne by residents.
The selected but differentiated inheritors make the first-person plural potentially social: unequal trajectories can converge in one grace-grounded home.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained several readings that a conservative synthesis could lose: rest without incapacitating stoppage, a split-root adornment resonance, a competing grace-created due, a reversal of hostile encirclement, and the end of prolonged temporal pursuit.
remaining_uncertainties: The later plural may include all three groups of inheritors or may narrow to an admitted subset.
Non-eroding residence may mean existence outside temporal attrition or endless life within an ordered succession.
The two exhaustion nouns may mark exertion and residual debility as phases, or may function mainly as intensifying near-synonyms.
The ornament, obligation, adverse-circle, and prolonged-pursuit branches are packet-licensed activations, but their audibility in the focus wording remains exploratory.

findings.text: Kalıcı yurt, yalnız sonsuz süre değil, sakinleri olumsuz hâller arasında döndüren çevrimin durdurulduğu yerleşik bir düzendir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Arrival becomes secure habitation when entry, residence, bodily adornment, and relief from exhausting contact all stabilize together.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The scene is architectural and somatic at once: a granted residence is fitted to the body with wrist ornaments and garments, while pain, grief, and fatigue lose the capacity to make contact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Entry and lasting residence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Entrants cross a threshold, are settled in a house-like station, and remain there as residents rather than temporary visitors.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: permanent residence (quranic:root_000992:B001/m01); settling in a place (quranic:root_000351:B002/m01); dwelling or fixed abode (quranic:root_001273:B006/m01); resident attached to a house (quranic:root_000499:B007/m01); entering an enclosure (quranic:root_000464:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 35:33 `يَدْخُلُ` (د خ ل); 35:35 `أَحَلَّ/دَارَ/مُقَامَةِ` (ح ل ل/د و ر/ق و م). The surface root ع د ن is unavailable in the bundle, so its permanent-residence motif cannot receive a token-level anchor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Entry is only the threshold operation. Settlement, house attachment, and permanent residence convert passage into a stable condition whose defining feature is not merely location but non-expulsion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Arrival becomes secure habitation when entry, residence, bodily adornment, and relief from exhausting contact all stabilize together.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The scene is architectural and somatic at once: a granted residence is fitted to the body with wrist ornaments and garments, while pain, grief, and fatigue lose the capacity to make contact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Contact without grief or fatigue
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Grief is removed, and neither effort nor exhaustion can reach the settled inhabitants as an affecting contact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: toil and fatigue (quranic:root_001507:B004/m01); weakness from exhaustion (quranic:root_001360:B001/m01); an effect reaching a person by contact (quranic:root_001423:B004/m01); grief as inward roughness (quranic:root_000317:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 35:34 `حَزَنَ` (ح ز ن); 35:35 `يَمَسُّ/نَصَبٌ/لُغُوبٌ` (م س س/ن ص ب/ل غ ب).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Relief is expressed as failed transmission: fatigue and weariness no longer touch the body, while grief has already departed the interior. The dwelling is therefore secure at both the external and affective boundaries.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Intended action accrues to its agent and returns as a consequence that can increase rank or compound loss.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Commerce, growth, precedence, and earned acquisition make consequence cumulative and agent-bound rather than a single externally imposed event.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Increase, advantage, and compounded loss
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A position can grow into surplus and precedence, while a losing transaction compounds the deficit already attached to its agent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: general loss or diminution (quranic:root_000409:B001/m01); commercial loss (quranic:root_000409:B002/m01); increase and growth (quranic:root_000657:B001/m01); surplus beyond sufficiency (quranic:root_001163:B001/m01); advantage or higher degree (quranic:root_001163:B002/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Increase and loss are directional accumulations, not binary verdicts. The trade sense of loss makes disbelief a worsening account, while surplus and degree show the opposite possibility of value exceeding its starting measure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A maximally strengthened pledge creates an obligation of receptivity, but the arrival of its promised warning can still disclose withdrawal rather than guidance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Divine naming, life-stakes adjuration, arrival, and bodily recoil expose the distance between verbal commitment and enacted response.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Strengthened pledge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Speakers invoke the divine name and bind themselves with their strongest oath, treating the pledge as an obligation that must later be discharged.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: oath as binding speech (quranic:root_001226:B004/m01); oath used for confirmation (quranic:root_001698:B003/m01); divine name invoked in oath (quranic:root_000047:B002/m01); adjuration by life (quranic:root_001044:B002/m01); discharging a sworn obligation (quranic:root_000351:B005/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The oath is a speech act with maximal force, not evidence of later compliance. Invoked name, life-stakes force, and discharge sharpen the subsequent failure by specifying what the speakers claimed to bind.

facets.statement: Borç, hak veya yaptırım bağlayıcı ve yerine getirilmesi gereken duruma gelir.
Ceza bildiren bağlamda ifade, zorunlu hale gelme yanında inip gerçekleşme olarak da okunabilir.
Kurbanlık, kesilmesinin öngörüldüğü yere veya zamana erişir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, borç veya hakkın vadesine erişmesi ve yaptırımın artık gerçekleşecek duruma gelmesidir; ceza bağlamında zorunluluk ile iniş okumaları ayrışır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Borç, hak, yaptırım ve belirlenmiş varış noktası bağlamlarındaki erişilmiş sınırı birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlayıcılık aşamasına erişmeyi ve bağlama bağlı gerçekleşme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir borcun veya hakkın artık ödenmesi ya da yerine getirilmesi gerektiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükümlülüğün belirlenmiş zamana ulaşıp bağlayıcı olmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Cezanın inmesi ve kurbanlığın belirlenmiş yere veya zamana ulaşması anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bağlayıcı bir ant içinden istisna veya onu çözen bir işlemle çıkmayı temel alır ve buradan yalnızca gereği yerine getirecek kadar az eylem anlamını türetir. Az vurma örneği çekirdeğin kendisi değil, bu ölçülü gerçekleştirme uzantısıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ant çözme kuruluşuna ve ondan türeyen en az ölçüye bağlıdır; genel izinli olma anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ant çözme ve buna bağlı azlık kuruluşlarıyla sınırlıdır; bunlardan yalın kök için genel bir anlam çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bağlayıcı bir ant içinden istisna koyarak veya onu çözen gereği yerine getirerek çıkmaktır. Buradan, bir işi yalnızca gerekli en düşük ölçüde ve aşırıya gitmeden yapma anlamı gelişir.

facets.statement: Ant, istisna ya da onu çözen yeterli işlem aracılığıyla bağlayıcılığını yitirir.
Çözme için yeterli en düşük ölçü, başka eylemlerin az ve aşırılıksız yapılmasına örnek olur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ant bağının çözülmesini temel alır ve yalnızca gereği karşılayan az miktardaki eylemi bu temel üzerinden açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: anttan çıkma ve en az gereği yerine getirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Ant bağını çözen işlemi ve bundan türeyen ölçülü, en az düzeyde eylem kullanımını birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Ant bağının çözülmesini ve yeterli en düşük ölçü uzantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ant içildikten sonra bir istisna koyarak bağlayıcılıktan çıkma bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ant bağını istisna aracılığıyla çözme işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ant gereğini başka yolla karşılama ve az eylem uzantısını kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi erkek ve kadın eşi, aynı yerde yaşama gerekçesiyle temel kullanım olarak verir ve aynı konuta inen ya da yakın komşu olan kişiyi de kapsar. Eş anlamı merkezde, birlikte oturma ilişkisi ise açık bir uzantıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal eşlik ve aynı yerde oturma ilişkisini bildirir; izin durumu veya giysi takımı anlamıyla ilgili değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, türemiş adların eş ve birlikte oturan komşu anlamlarını doğrudan kapsar; kuruluşlara özgü başka anlam eklemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin evlilik bağı içindeki eşi, özellikle aynı yerde birlikte oturan hayat ortağıdır. Aynı konuta inen veya yakın komşu olan kişi de bu birlikte oturma ilişkisiyle adlandırılabilir.

facets.statement: Kadın veya erkek, evlilik bağı içindeki karşılıklı eş olarak adlandırılır.
Aynı konutta bulunan ya da yakın komşu olan kişi, birlikte oturma ilişkisi nedeniyle bu adlandırmaya katılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar eş anlamında birleşir ve bu adlandırmayı aynı yerde oturma veya yakın komşuluk ilişkisiyle açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: eş veya birlikte oturan yakın kişi

error_profile.preserves: Eş anlamını ve birlikte oturmaya dayalı komşu uzantısını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu giysiyi alt ve üst örtüden oluşan, tek parçaya indirgenmeyen bir takım olarak tanımlar. Bir kaynakta Yemen dokumalarına yapılan gönderme takım olma koşulunu kaldırmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi erkek üreme organındaki idrar çıkışını ve meme ya da memedeki süt çıkışını aynı bedensel kanal türü olarak verir. Dal sıvının toplandığı organı değil, dışarı çıktığı geçidi adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi adı oğlak, annesinin karnı yarılarak çıkarılan oğlak ve genel olarak küçük koyun yavrusu için tanıklar. Geçici çerçevedeki bir işaretle yenebilir kılınma koşulu bu branch claim içinde desteklenmediğinden tanıma alınmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal küçük koyun veya keçi yavrusu ve özellikle annesinin karnı yarılarak çıkarılan yavruyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, iki yalın adın küçük sürü hayvanı yavrusu anlamını verir; desteklenmeyen bir tören veya işaret koşulu eklemez.

concept_map.definition: Yeni doğmuş küçük bir koyun veya keçi yavrusu, özellikle annesinin karnı yarılarak çıkarılan oğlaktır.

facets.statement: Adlandırılan varlık yeni doğmuş küçük bir koyun ya da keçi yavrusudur.
Bazı kullanımlarda yavru, annesinin karnı yarılarak çıkarılmış oğlak olarak belirlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar oğlak anlamında birleşir; tanım ayrıca annesinin karnı yarılarak çıkarılan yavruyu ve küçük koyun yavrusu adlandırmasını kapsar.

concept_gloss.text: yeni doğmuş oğlak veya küçük koyun yavrusu

error_profile.preserves: Oğlak çekirdeğini, küçük koyun yavrusu kapsamını ve özel çıkarılma biçimini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaynakların özel olarak çıkarılma biçimini belirttiği bağlamlarda açıklayıcı karşılık olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Oğlağı ve annesinin karnı yarılarak çıkarılması koşulunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu koşul belirtilmeden kullanılan genel küçük koyun veya keçi yavrusu anlamını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: oğlak ya da annesinin karnı yarılarak çıkarılan küçük yavru

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da küçük koyun yavrusunu adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal keçi yavrusunu ve özel çıkarılma koşulunu da kapsar; komşu dal türü koyunla ve yaş evresiyle sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir oğlak veya küçük koyun yavrusu adını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Koyun, keçi ve bazı yaban hayvanlarının yavrularını topluluk adıyla daha geniş kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da koyun ve keçinin küçük yavrularını kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tekil ve daha özel bir yavru adıdır; komşu dal tür ve sayı bakımından daha geniş bir yavru sınıfıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi topluluğu yerinden kaldırmayı, bir şeyin yerinden ayrılmasını ve deveyi yürütmek için söylenen özel çağrıyı birlikte tanıklar. Ortak yön, bulunduğu yerde duran varlığın hareket ettirilmesi veya hareket etmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yerden ayrılma ya da ayırma kuruluşlarına bağlıdır; bir yere inip yerleşmenin ters yönündedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, topluluğu kaldırma, yerinden ayrılma ve deveye seslenme kuruluşlarını ayrı yüzler olarak korur; yalın anlam üretmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğu bulunduğu yerden kaldırıp uzaklaştırmak veya bir şeyin yerinden ayrılıp hareket etmesidir. Deveyi harekete geçirmek için söylenen özel çağrı da bu eyleme bağlı bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Duran kişi, topluluk veya şey bulunduğu yerden ayrılır ya da ayrılmaya zorlanır.
Deveye yöneltilen özel çağrı, hayvanı yerinden hareket ettirme amacı taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yerinden kaldırma ve yerinden ayrılma anlamlarında birleşir; deveye söylenen hareket çağrısını da bu alana bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ettirgen uzaklaştırma, kendiliğinden yer değiştirme ve hayvanı yürütme çağrısını ortak hareket çekirdeğinde temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Yer bağının bozulmasını, ettirgen ve geçişsiz yönleriyle birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun bulunduğu yerden zorla veya yönlendirmeyle uzaklaştırılması anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir varlığı bulunduğu yerden ayıran ettirgen hareketi korur.
error_profile.loses: Kendiliğinden ayrılma ve deveye söylenen hareket çağrısını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bulunduğu yerden ayrılmak ya da kımıldamak

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal geçişsiz hareketi ve deve çağrısını da içerir; komşu dal kişi üzerinde yapılan ettirgen uzaklaştırmaya daha sıkı bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ettirgen kaldırmayı ve hayvanı çağrıyla yürütmeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin konumundan uzaklaşmasını, özellikle güneşin gökteki yerinden kaymasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın geçişsiz kullanımında bir şey bulunduğu konumdan ayrılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kuruluşlara bağlı olarak ayrılma ve ayırmayı birlikte taşır; komşu dal daha genel konum değişimini ve özel bir göksel örneği kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; ettirgen uzaklaştırma ile genel yer değişimi, kuruluş sınırlarını en iyi açıklayan iki ilişkidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözü geçen kişiyi önder, sağlam duruşlu ve yiğit olarak tanımlar; cimrilik ve içine kapanıklığın karşıtı da bu olumlu karakter çerçevesini açıklar. Yaşlılık bu kimliğin bir parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sağlam karakter ve yiğitlikle nitelenen öndere özgüdür; yalnızca yaşlı veya yalnızca yüksek konumlu kişiyi anlatmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın kişi adının önderlik ve olumlu karakter bileşimini korur; komşu kuruluş anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Sağlam duruşu, yiğitliği ve eli sıkı olmayan açık karakteriyle öne çıkan bir önderdir.

facets.statement: Kişi topluluk içinde önder konumundadır ve sağlam duruşludur.
Yiğitlik ve cimrilikten uzak açık karakter, önderlik niteliğini belirginleştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kişiyi sağlam duruşlu bir önder olarak tanımlar; yiğitlik ve cimrilikten uzaklık bu niteliği tamamlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Önderlik konumunun sağlam duruş, cesaret ve eli açıklıkla birlikte vurgulandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Önderliği, sağlam duruşu, yiğitliği ve cimrilikten uzak olmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin topluluk içindeki önderliği ile cesareti birlikte öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Önderlik ve yiğitlik bileşenlerini kısa bir doğal ifadeyle korur.
error_profile.loses: Sağlam duruş ve cimrilikten uzaklık niteliklerini açıkça söylemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sağlam duruşlu, yiğit ve eli açık önder

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir topluluğun başında bulunan kişiyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal liderlik yanında belirli erdemleri kurucu özellik yapar; komşu dal yalnızca topluluk içindeki baş olma konumunu bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yiğit, sağlam ve eli açık önder tipini bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin toplumsal değerini ve davranış niteliğini değerlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olumlu önderlik ve karakter özelliklerini birleştirir; komşu dal toplumsal ve ahlaki geriliği betimler, ancak tam sözlük karşıtı değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yol yükünü, kadınların bindiği bir taşıtı ve istenen yerde konmayı sağlayan taşınabilir araç takımını birlikte verir. Bunlar, yolculuk ve geçici konaklama için taşınan donanım ortaklığında tutulabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal taşınabilir yol ve konak donanımıyla sınırlıdır; genel izin durumu veya giysi takımı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yol yükünü bildiren kuruluş ile taşınabilir konak araçlarını bildiren yalın biçim ayrılır; kadın taşıtı ayrı bir uzantı olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Yolculukta taşınan yük takımı ve kişinin istediği yerde konmasını sağlayan kap, öğütme aracı, kova ve benzeri taşınabilir gereçlerdir. Kadınların yolculukta bindiği bir taşıt da bu donanım alanına katılır.

facets.statement: Yolcu veya yük hayvanıyla birlikte taşınan yol ve konaklama eşyası adlandırılır.
Kap, öğütme aracı, kova, bıçak ve benzeri gereçler hareketli konak takımını oluşturur.
Kadınların yolculukta kullandığı bir binek veya taşıt da aynı adla anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yol yükü ve hareketli konak gereçleri anlamlarını birlikte verir; kadınlar için kullanılan taşıt bu alanın ayrı bir uzantısıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yol yükünü, konaklama gereçlerini ve yolculuk taşıtı uzantısını ortak donanım alanında temsil eder.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yolculuk ve istenen yerde konma gereksinimine bağlıdır; komşu dal çok farklı yaşam olayları için hazırlanmış donanımı kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi deve ve atta arka ayak bileği veya ona bağlı dokulardaki zayıflık, gevşeklik ve sarkmayı açıkça tanımlar. Bu, genel bacak güçsüzlüğünden daha yerel ve hayvana özgü bir bedensel kusurdur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal deve veya atın arka ayak bileği çevresindeki gevşeklik ve zayıflıktır; yer değiştirme anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın ad ve sıfatın deve veya attaki yerel arka ayak kusuru anlamını verir; kuruluşlara bağlı hareket anlamlarını dışarıda tutar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi yalın adı doğrudan susamdan elde edilen yağ olarak tanımlar. Düğüm çözme, izin ve konma anlamlarıyla biçim benzerliği dışında ortak bir kurucu özellik verilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca susamdan çıkarılan yağdır; başka yağları veya kökün eylem anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın adın yalnızca susam yağı anlamını korur ve benzer biçimli diğer dallardan anlam aktarmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kadınların taktığı ziynet eşyasını, kılıç gibi nesnelere eklenen süsü ve bilezik takarak süslenme kullanımını birlikte açıkça destekler. Bu çerçeve, dalın hem süs eşyasını hem de belirli yapılardaki takma eylemini kapsayan kimliğiyle uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, nitelik bildiren betimleme anlamını, bir kaynaktan iyilik elde etmeyi ve bitki adlandırmasını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, takı ve süs eşyası bildiren biçimleri temel alır; bilezik takma ve takılı olma anlamlarını ise yalnızca kanıtlanan yapılara bağlı ayrı yönler olarak korur.

concept_map.definition: Kadının taktığı ziynet eşyasını veya kılıç gibi bir nesneye eklenen süs parçasını ifade eder. Belirli yapılarda bu tür eşyaları takma, özellikle bileziklerle süslenme ve takılı olma durumunu da anlatır.

facets.statement: Takılarak ya da bir nesneye eklenerek görünüşü süsleyen somut bir eşyadır.
Kadının üzerinde taşıdığı ziynet eşyasını, tekil ya da toplu biçimde adlandırır.
Kılıç gibi bir nesnenin üzerine eklenen süsleme parçasını da kapsar.
Kanıtlanan yapılarda takı takmayı, bileziklerle süslenmeyi veya takılı olmayı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çerçevesi, kadınların taktığı ziynet eşyasını ve kılıç benzeri nesnelerin süsünü aynı dalda toplar; ayrıca takı, özellikle de bilezik takma kullanımını destekler.

concept_gloss.text: takı, süsleme parçası ve bunları takma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın somut süs eşyası çekirdeğini ve yalnızca kanıtlanan yapılardaki takma ya da süslenme yönünü birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Takı, nesne süsü ve bunları takma yönlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kadının üzerinde taşıdığı ziynet eşyasından söz edilen bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kadının taktığı somut ziynet eşyası anlamını eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıç gibi bir nesnenin üzerine eklenen somut süsten söz edildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir nesneye eklenen somut süs parçası anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Takı veya bilezik takma eylemini bildiren kanıtlanmış yapılarda doğal bir yüklem karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Takı takarak süslenme eylemini ve sonucundaki görünümü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: takı veya nesneye eklenen süsleme parçası

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Takı veya nesneye eklenen süs eşyasını ve bunları takma yapılarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ev, arazi veya kişi gibi çok çeşitli varlıkları fiziksel olarak süslemenin genel alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişinin ya da nesnenin görünüşünü somut yollarla güzelleştirme alanına girer.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, takılan veya nesneye eklenen süs eşyasını adlandırır ve yalnızca belirli yapılarda bunları takma eylemine uzanır. Komşu dal ise belirli bir süs eşyası türüne bağlı olmadan genel süsleme eylemini ve sonucunu kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bilezik dışında kalan takıları, nesne süslerini ve bunlarla süslenme yapılarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle eli çevreleyen bileziği ve birine bilezik takma türevlerini merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bilezik, odak dalın kapsadığı takı türlerinden biridir ve iki dal takıyla süslenme bağlamında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal belirli bir takı türünü, yani eli çevreleyen bileziği odağa alır. Odak dal ise bileziği yalnızca bir örnek olarak içerir; kadın takılarının ve nesnelere eklenen süslerin daha geniş alanını kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği, bir şeyin niteliği ile bir kişinin yüzünü sözle betimleme edimidir ve geçici çerçeveyi destekler. Bununla birlikte aynı kanıt kılıç üzerindeki fiziksel süsü de anar; bu kullanım birinci dalın alanındadır ve betimleme anlamının parçası sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca nitelik ve betimlemeyi kapsar; kanıttaki kılıç süsü, fiziksel süs dalıyla sınır oluşturan ayrı bir kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, nitelik bildiren biçim ile bir kişinin yüzünü betimleme yapısını ayrı tutar; fiziksel süs kullanımını bu dalın çekirdeğine katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin onu tanıtan niteliğini ve bir kişinin yüzünü sözle betimleme edimini ifade eder. Kanıtta ayrıca anılan kılıç süsü, fiziksel süs dalına aittir ve bu betimleyici çekirdeği genişletmez.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi tanıtan veya nasıl olduğunu bildiren nitelik ve betimleyici özelliktir.
Kanıtlanan yapıda bir kişinin yüzünü sözle anlatma ve özelliklerini belirtme edimidir.
Kanıttaki kılıç süsü fiziksel bir süsleme parçasıdır ve betimleme çekirdeğinin dışında tutulmalıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyin niteliği ile bir kişinin yüzünü betimleme kullanımını destekler. Aynı toplu kanıtta geçen kılıç süsü ise fiziksel süs anlamıyla sınır çizer ve bu dalın çekirdeğine alınmaz.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel süs anlamı dışarıda tutulduğunda, dalın özellik bildiren biçimini ve yüz betimleme yapısını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Nitelik ile sözlü yüz betimlemesi arasındaki bağlı kapsamı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin nasıl olduğunu bildiren özellikten söz edilen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi tanıtan ve nasıl olduğunu bildiren özellik anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin yüz görünüşünü sözle anlatma edimini bildiren yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yüzün özelliklerini sözle anlatma edimini eksiksiz biçimde korur.
Kanıtta sınır oluşturan fiziksel süs kullanımını yansıtır.
error_profile.loses: Nitelik bildirme ve bir kişinin yüzünü sözle betimleme çekirdeğini siler.
error_profile.adds: Bu dala ait olmayan somut ziynet eşyası anlamını merkeze taşır.
error_profile.collision: Birinci dalın fiziksel takı ve süsleme parçası anlamıyla çakışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin niteliğini adlandırır ve özel bir yapıda kişinin yüzünü betimlemeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel olarak bir şeyi nitelikleriyle anlatmayı, durum ve belirtiyi, ayrıca dil bilgisel sıfatı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir varlığı onun özelliklerini belirterek tanıtma ve betimleme alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal nitelik adını ve özellikle yüzü betimleyen kanıtlanmış yapıyı bir arada taşır. Komşu dal ise betimleme eylemini ve nitelik kavramını daha genel kapsamda, dil bilgisel kullanıma kadar genişleterek ele alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir varlığın betimleyici niteliğini ve yüzü sözle anlatma edimini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İyi veya kötü olabilen tek bir karakter özelliğini ya da huyu merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişiye veya şeye yüklenen ayırt edici bir özellikten söz edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, bir şeyi tanıtan betimleyici niteliğe dayanır ve yüzü anlatma edimine uzanır. Komşu dal ise özellikle iyi ya da kötü bir karakter özelliğini adlandırır; betimleme eylemini içermez.
